caption: Fig.2.17 Order of filling of orbitals
note: The caption is printed "Fig.2.17" with no space after "Fig.", unlike the other figures in this chapter, and is kept that way. The artwork is a diagonal-rule diagram: 19 orbital labels sit in circles on a grid (rows 1-7 downward, s/p/d/f columns rightward) and solid diagonal arrows run from upper right to lower left, joined end-to-start by dashed curves. Labels are listed in the order the PROCESS flows - following each arrow in turn - not by spatial top-left-to-bottom-right position, because the whole point of the figure is the filling sequence and the two readings disagree (e.g. 4s is traversed before 3d although 3d is printed a row higher). What the flat list cannot represent: the grid position of each circle, the grouping of labels into the eight diagonal arrows, and the dashed jumps from the end of one diagonal to the start of the next. The arrows, circles and dashed curves are artwork, not labels. Excluded from the grown crop (outside target_box_in_crop): the orbital sequence line and the "The order may be remembered by using the method given in Fig. 2.17. Starting from" paragraph above, the whole right-hand column ("Pauli E...", "Hund's ..."), and the footer "2024-25".
